name: Theme Forge 主题工坊
description: 给 agent 的 AI 主题工作台：用一句自然语言描述想要的样子，agent 生成主题 CSS 并经运行时主题注册表实时应用到整个应用——即见即所得，不满意就继续改，满意后一键导出 CSS。内置主题列表/移除/一键恢复系统主题，全部经宿主主题策略消毒，零出网、零文件访问。

en.name: Theme Forge
en.description: An AI theme workbench for the agent: describe the look you want in one sentence, the agent generates theme CSS and applies it live to the whole app through the runtime theme registry — instant preview, iterate on feedback, export the CSS when satisfied. Includes theme listing, removal and one-tap reset to the system theme. Sanitized by the host theme policy; zero network, zero file access.
en.safetyNotes: No network egress, no filesystem access. The plugin can only create, update and remove themes registered under its own id (plugin:io.github.muzimu217.theme-forge:*); all CSS passes the host theme sanitizer (size cap, no url()/imports) before it is applied. Applying a theme changes the app appearance only; one action restores the system theme at any time. Exported CSS goes to the clipboard only.

author: muzimu217

agentTools.name: theme_forge
agentTools.description: Generate and apply a live theme to the whole app from a natural-language description. Actions: apply (css + label + base[light|dark] + activate[default true] — creates or updates a theme and re-themes the app instantly), list (forged themes), remove (themeId), reset (restore the system theme), export (copy a theme's CSS to the clipboard). Write theme CSS as variable overrides layered on the chosen base palette (light/dark); url() and @import are refused. Iterate on the user's feedback; export only when the user is satisfied.

css.description: apply only: theme CSS, variable overrides layered on the base palette.

base.description: apply only: base palette. Default dark.

activate.description: apply only: switch the app to the theme immediately. Default true.

themeId.description: remove/export only: the theme id from the list action.

changelog: 0.1.0：首个版本——theme_forge agent 工具（apply 实时生成并应用主题 CSS/list 列出工坊主题/remove 移除/reset 一键恢复系统主题/export 导出 CSS 到剪贴板）；应用即全宿主实时换肤，无需重启；应用历史存插件设置（近 20 条）；i18n 双语。
safetyNotes: 零出网、零文件访问。插件只能创建/更新/移除挂在自己 id 下的主题；所有 CSS 先经宿主主题消毒器（大小上限、禁 url()/导入）再应用。应用主题只改变应用外观，reset 随时恢复系统主题。导出的 CSS 仅进入剪贴板。
